subject: Shiny app user credentials (id and password) to be used by OdbcConnect

messages.author: f0091dcdc2bddc40
messages.subject: Shiny app user credentials (id and password) to be used by OdbcConnect
parts:
Hi all -
 
I want to create a widget to capture user's input and password and then transfer it to OdbcConnect in Server.R. Is there a way to do that?
 
I was able to create a textbox and pass on the user input from ui.r to server.r. However, when I send those values back to OdbcConnect, it gives me this error --
 
DSN, USER ID and PASSWORD in a textbox or any other Shiny Widget and then I would like to pass on these user credentials to odbcConnect in server.r......
 
When I do it, I get this error --
 
Error in as.vector(x, "character") : 
  cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character'
 
It seems the user inputs are passed on as "reactive" vectors in Shiny and OdbcConnect is expecting a character vector...Not sure if there is a way to convert reactive vector to character inside server.R OR if there is any other way to do this.
 
any insights will be greatly appreciated.
 
regards,
 
Mudit
